required_result: mark covered journeys INCOMPLETE; do not claim complete process history

required_result: retain possible chamber exposure; do not mark exact or not observed exposed

input_challenge: same wafer has repeated exact chamber processing instances in the query window
required_result: retain one exposed wafer and provenance for both distinct event instances

input_challenge: source-linked maintenance events before and after the suspected window
required_result: report temporal context only; do not infer effect or cause

required_result: preserve version segments and accept only the explicitly approved alternative
oracle: independent fixed-answer route-version and exception case

input_challenge: repeated process instance has an explicit verified rework predecessor
required_result: retain both instances and provenance while excluding the rework instance from base route count

input_challenge: normal wafer shares exact exposure while abnormal wafer lacks an observed match
required_result: report both contradictions, no fabricated support, no statistical or causal conclusion

required_result: show membership at each event time, preserve typed split provenance, refuse conflicting endpoint keys

required_result: show only time-relevant source-declared lot-to-lot paths; exclude expired edges and sibling traversal

input_challenge: event row has a lot ID not declared by its approved source relationship
required_result: do not attach unrelated material edges; expose the missing key and keep lineage unknown

input_challenge: event-time uncertainty crosses the source relationship effective start
required_result: keep event-to-lot seed possible and report membership ambiguity

input_challenge: exact exposure event uncertainty crosses the relationship effective start
required_result: classify wafer unknown, not exposed or observed unexposed

input_challenge: route population contains no-row and chronology-uncertain members
required_result: show declared and observed denominators separately and never invent a route for no-row members

input_challenge: chamber field is present but omitted from process relationship keys
required_result: exclude chamber from equipment strata and disclose it as unverified context

input_challenge: duplicate process instance has one identical copy and one conflicting chamber value
required_result: collapse exact copies with a count, refuse the conflicting instance, and emit no investigation artifact

input_challenge: verified event lot has no split/merge rows in submitted material snapshot
required_result: report no connected path observed and keep material-edge completeness NOT_ESTABLISHED

input_challenge: material coverage record omits an entity, edge type/source, missing record, or full time bound
required_result: accept only source-linked declared scope with lot seed, required types/sources, full event-time uncertainty, and explicit unauthenticated status

input_challenge: actual process interval uncertainty crosses the event source relationship effectivity boundary while timestamp remains inside
required_result: keep exact exposure unknown for the crossing event; retain exact classification only for the interval fully inside effectivity

input_challenge: exposure and route coverage declares complete while naming an omitted process record, or omits the missing-record field
required_result: missing records keep nonmatching population members unknown, exclude them from comparator use, and prevent route conformance; the explicit field must be source-authorized

input_challenge: caller marks an expected route approved but supplies no source-authorized route-definition relationship
required_result: refuse route conformance until the route source relationship authorizes approval, route identity/version, and sequence fields

input_challenge: expected route definition relationship effectivity starts inside an event clock-uncertainty interval
required_result: report route definition effectivity uncertain, not a match or mismatch, and preserve route source/relationship provenance

input_challenge: outcome timestamp is present in a row but omitted from its approved relationship keys
required_result: refuse to use that timestamp for temporal strata or competing-hypothesis review

input_challenge: population includes normal/abnormal outcomes across product and time strata plus an event-bearing wafer with no outcome row
required_result: show only relationship-verified product/time strata, preserve selection denominators and missing outcomes, and keep association/cause unestablished

input_challenge: process-event timestamp is present but omitted from the approved wafer-step relationship keys
required_result: refuse chronology and event-time claims; do not use the caller field as verified event time

input_challenge: MCP typed rows omit their source or relationship from response provenance, or the approved relationship omits the query time key
required_result: reject the read before analysis; every typed row must be listed by the response and every plan relationship must authorize the timezone-aware time field

input_challenge: delayed and out-of-order event rows have recording times that would reverse event-time chronology and exposure
required_result: chronology and exact exposure use relationship-authorized process event time; recording time is displayed separately; complete coverage permits only the truly out-of-window wafer to be classified not observed exposed

input_challenge: two exact equipment patterns have the same outcome/exposure cross-tab and complete observation coverage
required_result: retain both verified competing equipment hypotheses, do not rank either as preferred, and leave association and cause unestablished

input_challenge: complete source-linked route histories include a verified route mismatch, a valid allowed route alternative, and normal/abnormal outcomes under the same route
required_result: show route/outcome/exposure groups descriptively with exact process and route-definition references; do not rank route causes or infer association or causality
